cohort: 104 primigravida women visiting the outpatient Obstetrics Department at King Abdulaziz University Hospital, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, aged 18 to 41 years.
finding: The preferred mode of delivery chosen by primigravid pregnant women was SVD; only 13.5% preferred C/S.
